paper: Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (PROBE, ICML 2026, arXiv 2605.24906)
training_set_in_paper: PROBE-DINOv2 (DINOv2 ViT-L/14 with registers, trained on the Reconstruction Training Set + PROBE samples). Only the released checkpoint (DINOv2_best_model_step_34999.pth, ModelScope shuinishaojiu/PROBE-AIGI-Detection) is evaluated here; the generator-probing and fine-tuning code is not released, so there is no SynthScope-trained checkpoint. Metric: balanced accuracy at 0.5 (positive = fake), mean over the paper's subsets (Table 1 Avg = mean of Tables 2-4); SynthScope's means.acc is the same quantity. Inference: official protocol (pad to the crop size, ImageNet normalisation, mean logit of non-overlapping 336 patches), exact parity with the official evaluate_dino.py. The paper's 7-benchmark Avg (93.9) is not comparable with our 5-benchmark mean because Chameleon and AIGI-Quality-Paradox were not run.

benchmarks.name: GenImage (8 subsets, val100k, fakes JPEG q96)
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy at 0.5 (mean of real and fake accuracy), mean over subsets

paper_number.note: Table 1 (Avg of Tables 2-4); the paper JPEG-compresses all generated images at quality 96.

our_number.note: 97.47 bAcc / 99.77 mAP, +0.67 vs the paper. Per subset (diff to the paper): midjourney 98.73 (-0.07); sdv1.4 99.41 (+0.01); sdv1.5 99.39 (-0.01); adm 93.22 (+2.22); glide 93.86 (+1.76); wukong 99.33 (-0.17); vqdm 98.76 (-0.14); biggan 97.07 (+2.07). Full val split, fakes JPEG q96 (reals untouched), 6000 + 6000 per generator except sdv1.5 8000 + 8000 (paper Table 12: 48k / 48k). ADM, GLIDE and BigGAN are about 2 points above the paper while SynthScope equals the official code on every file compared (34 parity images, WildRF, SynthWildX); the official code was not run on GenImage; the difference is on the paper's data or preprocessing side and could not be determined.
